stations.title: The callout log
stations.text: In the order it was typed, rope 101 before 3

stations.title: The council
stations.say: Clear at a glance. Thank you.

captions: At the end of the winter, Rhona needs the callouts in the order the council asks for.
Today the log is in the order it was typed, and nobody can find anything in it.
You write functions that sort by what each reader needs, and pick out what Rhona asks.
Now the council's list is longest first, and the hill reports go hill by hill.
The winter's report reads at a glance, and Rhona knows whether the year can close.
